reviewer: Amp local source and counterexample review; not independent external review
review_scope: The correction from a Set alias to members plus specified relational structure. Readiness covers the stated local contracts, not empirical interpretation, infinite arity or full downstream canonical parity.

findings.resolution: The old alias made its reduction theorem tautological. Configuration now retains members and selected Relation/ordered-participant associations. SC-D2 proves extensional identity over both components. SC-C1 exhibits identical member Sets with unequal Configurations, so forgetting structure is not an equivalence. Set remains derived extensional membership; Configuration is derived relational structure, not a new primitive.

Selected associations require realization, at least two participant positions, and incidence through a member Relation or participant. The finite interpretation rejects reversed unrealized roles for every valid Configuration. A selected Relation may have external participants, and members may be isolated. Discrete structure exists on every Set, including the empty Set. Neither complete connectivity nor participant closure is imposed.

The supplied carrier and realizes predicate remain interpretation, not a canonical classifier of actual Presences and fixed Relation roles. Lists cover finite arity only. SC-D2 is proved for this represented interpretation; SC-G1 explicitly retains adequacy, infinite-arity coverage and full downstream parity as unproved.

The State wrapper can retain the unequal structured values, proved by structuredStatesDiffer. Generic State and all existing downstream core structures are byte-unchanged. The full 52-job Lean build and finite executable pass; 74 evaluation tests and all 10 explorer tests pass. Their success establishes compatibility of these implementations, not full canonical parity.

Historical promotion records remain unchanged. The dossier, changelog and decision record explicitly supersede the alias claim. Stable identifiers, term counts, glyph paths, private-use slots, State's drawing and institutional Order are unchanged. The corrected explorer definition and members/associations/valid projection were rendered and inspected at desktop and narrow widths, including glyph mode.
